# Math Worksheet Studio
> Free printable mathematics practice generators. Worksheets and matching answer-key PDFs are generated in the browser without a student account.

Website: https://mathworksheetstudio.com/
Worksheets: https://mathworksheetstudio.com/worksheets/
About and accuracy policy: https://mathworksheetstudio.com/about/
Contact and corrections: https://mathworksheetstudio.com/contact/
Public source repository: https://github.com/garrison2025/Math_Works

## Accuracy and scope
- 51 existing core topic generators plus separate original mixed-skill and word-problem tools.
- The topic, selected options, generator version and random seed reproduce the same question set.
- Student questions and separate matching answer keys are available; worked steps are available only on supported topics.
- Grade pathways are suggestions, not certified curriculum coverage or test preparation endorsements.
- Box plots use the exclusive median-of-halves quartile convention.
- Printable protractors require a 100% print setting and an actual ruler measurement of the 50 mm calibration line.
- The public repository documents code and automated checks, not independent teacher approval.
- For errors, report the page, problem number, settings, seed and expected answer without student personal information.

This optional navigation file does not replace the human-readable HTML pages, robots.txt or sitemap.xml.
